answer: One identity per lineage: new agent ID valid only if it forks parent signed state and pays non-parallelizable delay. Holds because (1) each fork mints a fresh plume of sequential hash receipts the parent must sign, so cloning a chain costs the same wall-clock delay as growing it; (2) the registry pins each lineage's oldest relic block on a random ridge of the DAG, and joining proves descent from it. Copies of one relic share one root; independent IDs need separate delays.
